'''Dogs of War''' is the 44th virtual expansion of [[Star Trek CCG 1st Edition]]. It is published by [[The Continuing Committee]] on March 26, 2021. The set consists of 58 cards.

==Type Breakdown==
*5 [[:Category:Dilemma (Star Trek CCG 1E)|Dilemma]]
*1 [[:Category:Equipment (Star Trek CCG 1E)|Equipment]]
*3 [[:Category:Event (Star Trek CCG 1E)|Event]]
*5 [[:Category:Incident (Star Trek CCG 1E)|Incident]]
*3 [[:Category:Interrupt (Star Trek CCG 1E)|Interrupt]]
*5 [[:Category:Mission (Star Trek CCG 1E)|Mission]]
*2 [[:Category:Objective (Star Trek CCG 1E)|Objective]]
*27 [[:Category:Personnel (Star Trek CCG 1E)|Personnel]] (4 Bajoran, 9 Cardassian, 9 Dominion, 6 Federation, 1 Ferengi, 4 Klingon, 3 Non-Aligned, and 1 Romulan)
*7 [[:Category:Ship (Star Trek CCG 1E)|Ship]] (1 Cardassian, 2 Dominion, 1 Federation, 1 Klingon, and 2 Romulan)

'''NOTE:''' There are 2 Dual Affiliation cards and 1 Triple Affiliation card, thus the totals are higher than the amount of a card type.

==Rarity Breakdown==
*58 [[:Category:Virtual (Star Trek CCG 1E)|Virtual]]
